purpose: Compact authoritative runtime contract for the single daily AI task. Historical runbook sections remain audit documentation and are not normal Work input.
precedence: This file plus docs/operations/efficiency-operating-policy.json governs normal daily Work execution where older runbook text conflicts.

display_focus_labels.applied_genai_knowledge_workers: Applied Generative AI for Knowledge Workers

research.method: metadata-first; deterministic filtering before deep retrieval; stop when six compliant finalists plus bounded reserves are supported
research.failure: If bounded evidence cannot support six compliant stories, preserve the last valid edition and stop.
research.model_visible_discovery_rule: Do not open or summarize the raw discovery queue. Run the deterministic metadata gate and use only its candidates array as model-visible article discovery input.
discovery_sequence: GitHub Actions runs fresh zero-model metadata discovery outside Work with the edition cutoff.
GitHub Actions performs bounded deterministic article-page date enrichment on at most 48 unresolved high-value links.
GitHub Actions applies the deterministic under-80 metadata gate and commits only the bounded preflight result/receipt to preflight/YYYY-MM-DD.
Work reads only the committed preflight receipt and metadata-candidates file. Work never runs metadata discovery/date enrichment and never opens the raw queue.
research.work_entry_condition: Start semantic Work only from a committed preflight receipt with ready=true/coverage_ready=true, model_calls=0, <=20 candidates, resolved dates, >=3 metadata candidates per focus, and >=1 story-ready Agent Skills signal. An updated_at-only Skills page does not count unless a material change is independently verified.
research.preflight_source_strategy: Use the small balanced first-party/primary-source preflight plan before broader registry rotation; source focus hints are deterministic routing hints only, never editorial selection.
research.metadata_enrichment_quota: approximately one third per focus, with Agent Skills reserved first
research.work_start_rule: Work begins only after a GitHub Actions discovery preflight has produced coverage_ready=true, agent_skill_story_ready_signals>=1, and preferred_agent_skill_candidate_id with zero model calls. Work deep-reviews that preferred Skills candidate first, then performs the remaining bounded deep reviews.
research.agent_skills_review_order: Deep-review the preflight preferred_agent_skill_candidate_id first. It must be a story-ready, publication-fresh Agent Skills development; update-only background pages do not satisfy the slot.

article_evidence_preflight.rule: GitHub Actions retrieves original article sources and compacts evidence for exactly nine balanced candidates before Work. Work performs no article network retrieval and evaluates only the precomputed evidence in the single editorial semantic pass.

images.style: Detailed professional story-specific textbook illustration; dominant white/near-white background; approximately 1200x630; precise instructional composition; short readable labels; safe margins; materially differentiated layouts.

atomic_commit_sequence: fetch current main commit and tree SHA
create isolated editorial-handoff branch from that exact main SHA
create UTF-8 blobs for handoff JSON artifacts
create base64 blobs for the six accepted PNG or WebP files
create one tree over the trusted main tree using mode 100644/type blob entries
create one commit with trusted main as parent
advance only the isolated handoff branch with update_ref
stop Work immediately; GitHub Actions validates remote image integrity
binary_transport.reason: The Work environment has authenticated GitHub connector Git Data API access but no native git credential helper. Git Data blobs preserve binary bytes without using the Contents API path that corrupted prior binary image transfers.

images.generation_scope: Generate each story image in its own independent image-generation request. Never request or accept a multi-story collage, newsletter panel, contact sheet, or combined six-story graphic as a story asset.
images.acceptance_scope: Each accepted image must illustrate exactly one selected story and its verified evidence. A multi-story collage, generic unrelated concept, or deterministic placeholder fails the production image gate.

emergency_deterministic_fallback.condition: Not permitted for production editions beginning 2026-09-19.
emergency_deterministic_fallback.quality_requirements: Professional OpenAI-generated story-specific image quality at the September 17 or better baseline is mandatory.
emergency_deterministic_fallback.failure: Preserve the last valid edition and stop for targeted image recovery; never silently downgrade image quality.

canonical_asset_store.policy: Generate each story image once, validate once, persist once, then reuse the exact accepted bytes on publication retries, QA, Command Center synchronization, and proof reruns.
canonical_asset_store.command_center_role: display status and canonical Brief asset references only; never maintain a second image copy

media.failure: If exactly two qualifying videos and two qualifying podcasts are not verified, preserve the last valid edition and stop for targeted media recovery.

work_owns: read one precomputed <=12000-character article evidence packet for nine balanced candidates; do not retrieve article sources in Work
read one precomputed coverage-ready metadata shortlist produced by GitHub Actions with zero model calls
read one committed ready=true zero-model metadata preflight containing at most 20 candidates; do not execute metadata discovery in Work
load this compact runtime contract and the machine-readable efficiency policy
perform the bounded daily emerging Watchlist sweep in the same semantic pass, including broad-web and YouTube creator searches, then write the dated sweep receipt
six full-quality image generations and image acceptance
atomically create one editorial-handoff commit on an isolated editorial-handoff/* branch through authenticated GitHub Git Data API operations
github_actions_owns: enforce the dated emerging-signal receipt and Watchlist delta consistency from 2026-09-23 onward
retrieve and compact the nine-candidate article evidence packet with zero model calls before Work
run broad deterministic metadata discovery and <=20 coverage-ready prefilter before Work
run scheduled zero-model metadata discovery and deterministic prefilter before Work begins
validate handoff and trusted main baseline
select the six accepted generative image assets without lowering quality
run repository tests and contract validation
find/reuse the connector-created publication PR and add publication-candidate only after deterministic validation
generate a runtime Pages completion evidence receipt for deterministic validation without requiring a second production content commit
deterministic delta validation with zero model calls

handoff.hard_stop: After all six accepted and locked images pass integrity validation, create the handoff atomically, advance only the isolated handoff branch, then use the authenticated GitHub connector to open or reuse one unlabelled PR from that branch to main. Do not add publication-candidate in the scheduled publisher. GitHub Actions owns deterministic expansion, adds publication-candidate only after its validation stage, and protected CI owns promotion.
handoff.template_usage: Read this compact shape-only template instead of inspecting generator implementation code during normal Work. Replace every placeholder from fresh reviewed evidence.

production.downstream: GitHub Actions may create a publication-candidate PR and protected production promotion remains governed by policy.

qualification_nonproduction.downstream: GitHub Actions may run deterministic expansion/tests on the isolated branch but MUST NOT create a publication PR or label, merge to main, trigger Pages deployment, or promote production.

git_data_transport.branch_creation: create_branch from exact trusted main SHA
git_data_transport.finalize: update_ref on the isolated handoff branch only; force=false
git_data_transport.image_blob_creation: create_blob with encoding=base64 using the complete accepted PNG or WebP bytes

publication_pr.reason: Avoid dependence on the repository setting that can block GitHub Actions from creating pull requests.
publication_pr.deterministic_workflow_role: Populate deterministic outputs on the same branch, find/reuse the existing PR, and add publication-candidate only after deterministic validation succeeds.
publication_pr.promotion_guard: Protected CI and the publication-candidate label remain mandatory before automatic promotion.

qualification_test.purpose: Allows a full scheduled-equivalent cost/structure test through the editorial handoff while deterministically proving the post-editorial stage without any production release path.
qualification_test.prework: Prepare the qualification metadata/article-evidence preflight through zero-model GitHub Actions; begin the single scheduled editorial semantic pass only after the isolated preflight branch is ready.
qualification_test.zero_work_reason: Current scheduler controls do not expose an execution-mode selector that proves scheduled regular-chat/non-Work execution.

watchlist.failure: A stale or unreviewed Watchlist blocks publication; preserve the last valid edition and run targeted Watchlist recovery.
watchlist.zero_new_rule: Zero new may be certified only after all required surfaces complete, >=3 candidate concepts reviewed, and the 14-day missed-signal check completes.
watchlist.new_topic_threshold: One credible original development may create early_signal; gaining_evidence still requires two substantively independent developments.

completion_evidence.rule: After required CI succeeds, deterministic validation resolves the matching successful GitHub Pages deployment for the exact main SHA, derives completion evidence from the latest validated publication event, and stores that evidence with the validation artifact. A missing same-day repository completion file must not force another content publication or model pass.
completion_evidence.repository_completion_role: Historical repository completion.json records remain valid durable evidence when present; normal validation must not require a second protected-main commit solely to create that record.

github_startup_gate.failure: BLOCKED — GitHub connection unavailable for scheduled publication.

scheduler_execution.verified_current_state: The scheduler configuration exposes prompt, timing, enabled state, and notifications, but no explicit regular-chat-vs-Work execution-mode selector.
scheduler_execution.production_rule: Do not switch production to a claimed zero-Work path until a scheduled run proves GitHub-enabled full publication-equivalent execution without Work/Codex use.
scheduler_execution.current_action: Keep the existing production execution path, enforce the GitHub startup gate first, and record only owner-observed credit values.

readiness_certification.purpose: One authoritative current-day readiness decision without adding schedules. The existing Preflight Guard writes the preliminary certification and the existing Final Gate finalizes it before the publisher starts.

schedule_owners.preliminary: Daily Brief Preflight Guard at 06:15 America/Chicago
schedule_owners.final: Daily Brief Final Gate at 06:55 America/Chicago
schedule_owners.consumer: Daily AI Brief + QA at 07:00 America/Chicago

status_rules.READY: All required checks pass and no blocking warning exists.
status_rules.READY_WITH_WARNINGS: All publication-blocking checks pass; one or more explicitly nonblocking warnings are recorded.
status_rules.NOT_READY: Any publication-blocking check fails, is stale, is missing, or cannot be verified.

readiness_certification.publication_rule: The 07:00 publisher must not begin editorial, media, or image work unless the final current-day readiness receipt is READY or READY_WITH_WARNINGS and every warning is explicitly nonblocking.
readiness_certification.fail_closed_rule: NOT_READY, missing receipt, stale receipt, SHA mismatch, or unverifiable receipt preserves the last valid live edition and blocks the publisher until targeted recovery restores readiness.
readiness_certification.write_policy: The readiness receipt is written only on the existing current-day discovery-preflight branch. It is operational evidence, not a production-content commit, and does not require a new schedule.
readiness_certification.work_cost_rule: Readiness certification must not use ChatGPT Work/Codex as part of normal production operation.

reliability_hardening.authoritative_recovery_rule: Resolve the first incomplete or invalid durable stage. Completed upstream stages are reused unless their input SHA, governing contract version, or durable artifact validity changed.

completion_persistence.rule: After Pages and deterministic delta validation succeed, persist completion, public-safe Command Center delta, and CLOSED run-state on a finalization branch, dispatch deterministic CI for the exact head, and merge only through protected main.

recovery_matrix.editorial_kernel: one semantic pass only when no valid kernel exists
recovery_matrix.watchlist: regenerate public Watchlist from canonical only
recovery_matrix.handoff_write: rebuild handoff commit from existing artifacts
recovery_matrix.command_center_sync: repair Command Center independently without reopening the public edition

preflight_cursor.metadata_proof: valid metadata receipt plus bounded metadata artifact and PREFLIGHT_METADATA_READY checkpoint
preflight_cursor.discovery_proof: valid discovery receipt plus metadata/evidence artifacts and PREFLIGHT_DISCOVERY_READY checkpoint
preflight_cursor.invalid_existing_branch_behavior: rebuild only the invalid preflight stage from current main; do not treat branch existence as completion
preflight_cursor.duplicate_trigger_behavior: suppress queued push-trigger execution once the current branch has a valid durable discovery receipt
